def transform(grid):
    # Tile the patterned region into every compartment formed by the 6-colored dividers.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == 6 for c in range(w))]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 6 for r in range(h))]
    rbounds = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + cols + [w]
    regions = [(list(range(rbounds[i]+1, rbounds[i+1])), list(range(cbounds[j]+1, cbounds[j+1]))) for i in range(len(rbounds)-1) for j in range(len(cbounds)-1)]
    # select region with most nonzero content (template)
    sr, sc = max(regions, key=lambda rc: sum(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in rc[0] for c in rc[1]))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rr, cc in regions:
        for i, r in enumerate(rr):
            for j, c in enumerate(cc):
                if i < len(sr) and j < len(sc):
                    out[r][c] = grid[sr[i]][sc[j]]
    return out
PY
